answer: Every eye test ends with a signed chart, and the chart goes into a folder the clinic keeps for a decade. Proof of optometrist registration via national optical council roll works from the same folder: a roll the optical council has kept current since the first eye test. To fake one chart you need a pen and a quiet afternoon; to fake four hundred you need four hundred appointments, four hundred patients who never blinked, and the plume of each visit written in a hand the clinic recognises — the signal is the appointment book itself, the wander the folder where the charts sleep.
